senses.definition: vb. keep moving, stir (NH stir, move, especially of lips in speech, also, in expl. of מרחשׁת, of stewing, boiling; Aramaic רְחֵישׁ, ܪܚܶܫ, ܪܚܰܫ, creep, more, flutter, ܪܰܚܫܳܐ reptile);—
Pf. 3 ms. ר׳ לִבִּי דָּבָר טוֹב ψ 45:2 is astir.
